:::{#exm-absolutely-integrable}
#### Absolutely integrable and not

- For the counting measure on the die rolls $D$,
  $f(x) = x - 3$ (@exm-integral) is absolutely integrable:

  $$
  \begin{aligned}
  \int_D \abs{f} \, d\measure &= 2 + 1 + 0 + 1 + 2 + 3 \\
  &= 9 \\
  &< \infty
  \end{aligned}
  $$

  by @exm-integral-nonneg.
- For the counting measure on $\mathbb{N}$,
  the constant function $h(n) = 1$ is not absolutely integrable,
  because

  $$
  \begin{aligned}
  \int_{\mathbb{N}} \abs{h} \, d\measure &= \int_{\mathbb{N}} h \, d\measure \\
  &= \infty
  \end{aligned}
  $$

  (@exm-integral-nonneg).

:::
